reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI as product of collective creative labour
themes.definition: AI framed as an outcome of human creative work and productivity that can generate free time and a new basis of wealth.
themes.inclusion: Passages presenting AI as part of productivity gains from human labour and as a basis for a post-oil economy or more free time.
themes.exclusion: Passages about AI-driven job losses without the productivity/wealth framing.
themes.boundary_cases: Ideological framings of AI within socialism or post-capitalist visions count here when productivity is central.

examples.quote: the deep, creative and freely performed work that has made possible the high levels of productivity achieved today, including artificial intelligence

themes.label: Global public authority controlling AI
themes.definition: Demand that AI and productive capacity be controlled by a global public authority rather than a global oligarchy.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for public, collective or global-authority control over AI, set against oligarchic or private control.
themes.exclusion: Standard intergovernmental regulation calls without the public-ownership/control framing.
themes.boundary_cases: Also relates to concentration; code here when a global public authority is explicitly proposed.

examples.quote: that must be controlled by a global public authority

value.rationale: Single Colombian 2024 passage with a socialist framing: AI is a product of collective human labour and productivity that should be controlled by a global public authority against a global oligarchy.
